units.source_text: 对方的女儿年纪很小，甚至还不懂得拒绝主动向自己搭话的男子。

en.t: The other man's daughter was very young, so young that she did not even know how to refuse a man who took it upon himself to speak to her.

units.source_text: 她只具备唯一的条件，那就是选择最初向她求婚的男子。

en.t: She had only one condition, and that was to choose the first man who asked her to marry him.

units.source_text: 她心扑通扑通地跳，像做梦一般只顾点头，因此也自认为比较出色地作了种种思考，忘却了对方的健康等问题。

en.t: Her heart pounded, and as if in a dream she did nothing but nod; thinking she had considered everything rather well, she forgot such matters as the other person's health.

units.source_text: 即使觉察到了，也不懂得拒绝。

en.t: Even if she had noticed it, she would not have known how to refuse.

units.source_text: 相反，毋宁说连父母的模样都不知道的孤儿，是说服女孩子的好武器。

en.t: On the contrary, being an orphan who did not even know what his parents looked like was, if anything, a fine weapon for persuading a girl.

units.source_text: 不知多少女人听到之后，都“呀”的一声，那惊讶的眼神，给我投来了多么浓重而慷慨的感情啊！

en.t: How many women, on hearing it, had cried out in surprise, and with those startled eyes poured such deep and generous feeling toward me!

units.source_text: 也有很多女人背着父母或丈夫悄悄地给我零花钱。

en.t: Many women also secretly gave me spending money behind the backs of their parents or husbands.

units.source_text: 如果我倾诉苦衷，她们就马上露出噙住泪珠的神情。

en.t: If I poured out my troubles, they would at once show a look with tears welling in their eyes.

units.source_text: 年轻女子同情年轻男子而哭泣，这是完全抛弃理性，近于把感情放置在男子掌心上的情景。

en.t: When a young woman cries out of sympathy for a young man, it is a scene in which reason has been completely cast aside, almost as though her feelings have been placed in the man's palm.

units.source_text: 在这一瞬间闪过早丧双亲的孤儿也许会早死之类的想法，在很大程度上就不像个姑娘，而是个性情刚强的女人了。

en.t: If at that instant the thought flashes through her mind that an orphan who lost both parents early may also die young, then to a great extent she is no longer like a maiden, but rather a strong-willed woman.

units.source_text: 我没有运用向牧师馆勤杂工的女儿倾诉自己的境遇，以博得她落泪的策略。

en.t: I did not use the strategy of pouring out my circumstances to the daughter of the rectory handyman in order to draw tears from her.

units.source_text: 我只是说声“我想（与你）结婚”，她简单地回应一句“好”，事情就成了。

en.t: I merely said, "I want to marry you," and she answered simply, "All right," and that settled the matter.

units.source_text: 再说，我也没有说“我可能早死，你也认了吗”。

en.t: Besides, I did not say, "I may die young; do you accept that too?"

units.source_text: 我觉得自己没有这样说，对她仿佛是一种诈骗。

en.t: I felt that not having said this was almost a kind of fraud against her.

units.source_text: 我把这种诈骗的辩解留待将来再说。

en.t: I left the defense of this fraud for the future.

units.source_text: 凭借努力，虚弱者也可能成为健康者，不一定不能把寿命延长十年、二十年。

en.t: Through effort, even a weak person might become healthy, and it is not necessarily impossible to extend one's life by ten or twenty years.

units.source_text: 而且，我没有勇气坚决认定自己是个不能结婚的人，就像不能坚决相信自己会早死这种思绪渗透到心灵的每个角落一样。

en.t: Moreover, I did not have the courage to firmly decide that I was a person who could not marry, just as the thought that I would die young had not penetrated every corner of my heart as an unshakable belief.

units.source_text: 这两种东西，显示出自己阴暗的命运。

en.t: These two things revealed my own dark fate.

units.source_text: 我带着这种感情，沉湎在惆怅的忧郁中。

en.t: With these feelings in me, I sank into a melancholy full of sorrowful longing.

units.source_text: 但是，我对姑娘抱有自责的念头，这种心情让自己没有一时舒畅过。

en.t: But I carried a sense of guilt toward the girl, and that feeling never allowed me even a moment of ease.

units.source_text: 我把这种心情对A和B都隐藏了起来。因此，当B说“是战死的”的时候，我心想：“果然谁都这样认为吗？”从而感到自己仿佛被忽然推下深深的峡谷。

en.t: I hid this feeling from both A and B. Therefore, when B said, "He died in the war," I thought, "So everyone really does think that way?" and felt as though I had suddenly been pushed down into a deep ravine.
